walkthroughs.body_html:
Resistance is a textbook natural selection.

Reduce it: prescribe only when needed, finish the course, hospital hygiene, develop new antibiotics. and both expect this list.

For: more food per hectare, golden rice helps vitamin A deficiency, less pesticide use.

Against: corporate control of seeds, gene transfer to wild plants, long-term safety unknown.

Mitigate: renewables, electric vehicles, reforestation, carbon capture, dietary change.

Adapt: flood defences, drought-tolerant crops, heat-resilient infrastructure. can ask you to compare.
